name: ADS CAD3D Studio
one_liner: CAD drawings to semantic 3D building models with Layer Standardizer and Three.js QA viewer.
description: A local tool for Asure Design Studio that ingests consultant CAD drawings (DWG/DXF), standardizes every layer to the ten ADS standard layers, extracts a semantic building model per level, and exports to various formats including ADS Bridge JSON, IFC4, glTF+DAE, and Rhino 3dm.
efficiency_hint: 80/123 wall face segments paired into 40 extruded walls with zero manual work.
